skills.summary: Pick and document a branching model
skills.job: Choose a branching and merge model that fits the team and release rhythm, then write it down.
triggers: what branching strategy should we use
gotchas: Copying gitflow for a team that ships continuously
Long-lived branches hiding integration pain
Naming rules nobody enforces

skills.summary: Resolve merge conflicts without losing work
skills.job: Resolve merge or rebase conflicts by understanding both sides and verifying the result builds.
gotchas: Taking one side wholesale and dropping the other change
Leaving conflict markers that still compile
Resolving the same hunk wrong repeatedly during rebase

skills.job: Squash, reorder and reword local commits with a safe interactive rebase before opening a pull request.
gotchas: Rewriting commits already pushed and shared
Interactive editor blocking a non-interactive shell
Fixup commits landing on the wrong target

skills.summary: Find the commit that broke something
skills.job: Use git bisect with a repeatable test to locate the first bad commit.
triggers: find the commit that broke the build
gotchas: Flaky test marking good commits as bad
Commits that do not build confusing the search
Forgetting to run bisect reset

skills.job: Get back commits, branches or stashes after a bad reset, rebase or branch delete using the reflog.
triggers: I deleted my branch by accident
gotchas: Running gc or clean before recovering
Reflog entries expiring and being local only
Recovering onto the current branch instead of a new one

skills.summary: Tag releases with versions and notes
skills.job: Choose the next version, create an annotated tag and push it without breaking existing releases.
triggers: what version number should this be
create a git tag for v2
gotchas: Lightweight tags used where annotated are needed
Moving a published tag
Tagging the wrong commit on a release branch

skills.job: Find files that should be ignored or already tracked by mistake and fix ignore rules safely.
triggers: remove tracked file from git but keep it
gotchas: Ignoring a file that is already tracked does nothing
Negation rules blocked by an ignored parent directory
Removing a secret from tracking but not from history

skills.summary: Purge large files from repo history
skills.job: Find oversized or sensitive blobs in history and remove them with a rewrite plan the team can follow.
triggers: remove a big file from git history
gotchas: Rewriting history without telling collaborators
Forks and clones keeping the old blobs
Rotating credentials skipped because history was cleaned

skills.job: Write a CODEOWNERS file that routes reviews to the right people and test its patterns.
gotchas: Last matching pattern wins, not first
Owners without write access are ignored
Wide wildcard owners creating review bottlenecks

skills.summary: Split work into stacked pull requests
skills.job: Break a large change into a chain of small dependent pull requests and keep the stack in sync.
gotchas: Squash-merging the base orphaning child branches
Wrong base branch on child PRs
Review comments fixed in the wrong layer
